name: customer-photo-grid
title: Customer photo grid
description: A tight grid of customer photos, each linking to the original post, with the handle and caption on the tile and a call to share yours.
docs: Pass title, an optional description, photos ({ id, photo, alt, handle, caption?, href }), an optional cta ({ label, href }) and an optional permission line ('Shared with permission'). Three across on a desktop and two on a phone. The strip under every photo is the link to the original post: it is named by the handle and the caption, exactly what is written on it, and it stretches over the whole tile so the photo is part of the target. The handle and caption are always visible, never on hover only, and the handle wraps on a narrow tile instead of being cut short; the alt text, which is required, describes the picture. Photos are cropped to a square through AspectRatio, so nothing shifts as they load, and they load lazily. The call to action is a Button link; permission is plain text next to it.
